subject.title: fix(gateway): generate dashboard titles despite sender metadata

question: Should generated dashboard titles retry once through the primary model when a distinct configured or provider-default utility model fails, accepting the additional provider route and cost?
rationale: The retry intentionally changes behavior for existing utility-model failures and may exercise different credentials or provider routing; PR-body confirmation is useful evidence but protected maintainer handling requires an explicit decision on the reviewed head.

options.title: Confirm bounded retry
options.body: Accept one primary-model retry only after a distinct utility model fails, with the documented provider-routing and cost behavior.

options.title: Keep utility failures terminal
options.body: Preserve the previous failure behavior and merge only the dashboard sender-metadata correction.

recommendation.title: Confirm bounded retry
recommendation.body: Accept one primary-model retry only after a distinct utility model fails, with the documented provider-routing and cost behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author supplied the routing rationale and stated that maintainer confirmation was obtained, making them the best available person to route the confirmation.
